title: P-link3: link_preview_proxy needs at least one non-empty Uri
description: room-policy-04 §6.3: when link_preview_proxy_use is optional/required the policy 'MUST include the URI' of the proxy, but link_preview_proxy is a vector. Chosen: at least one non-empty Uri; extra entries (including empty ones) are kept; not 'exactly one' (unlike parent_room).
